text: A decentralized autonomous organization is merely computer code with no directors, managers or employees, its governance structure built with software, code and smart contracts running on a public decentralized blockchain platform.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in a Digital Age Why 'Coding for Lawyers' Matters (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3227967

isBasedOn.name: Legal Education in a Digital Age Why 'Coding for Lawyers' Matters

abstract: DAOs are "merely" computer code. They don't have any directors, managers or employees. The governance structure is built with and on software, code and smart contracts that ran on a public decentralized blockchain platform (in most cases Ethereum).

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: DAOs built on public platforms, in most cases Ethereum
